title: 大型 MPI 平行模擬
summary: 以域分解、訊息語意與數值平行驗證串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect domain decomposition, message semantics and numerical parallel validation with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 問題與分解
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「問題與分解」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop problems and decomposition through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 域分解：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「域分解」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for domain decomposition.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「域分解」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：空間分塊決定計算與跨塊依賴。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「把自製二維格網分為四塊。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for domain decomposition. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Spatial partitioning defines compute and interblock dependencies. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Partition a self-made 2D grid into four blocks. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 把自製二維格網分為四塊。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Partition a self-made 2D grid into four blocks. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 空間分塊決定計算與跨塊依賴。

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 玩具 3D 網格每子域邊長 L，體點 L³、單層六面 halo≈6L²，通訊體積比≈6/L。L=32 得 0.1875，L=64 得 0.09375；未含邊角、重疊與協議頭，不等於通訊時間比例。
knowledge.textEn: For a toy cubic subdomain, L3 interior cells and roughly 6L2 one-layer halo cells give volume ratio 6/L: 0.1875 at L32 and 0.09375 at L64, excluding edges, overlap and framing; not a time fraction.

quiz.question: 審查「域分解」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for domain decomposition?
options: 分塊越細就無條件降低總耗時。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「域分解」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
空間分塊決定計算與跨塊依賴。
optionsEn: Finer blocks always reduce total runtime.
One matching output proves domain decomposition for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Spatial partitioning defines compute and interblock dependencies.
quiz.explanation: 空間分塊決定計算與跨塊依賴。 把自製二維格網分為四塊。 因此「分塊越細就無條件降低總耗時。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Spatial partitioning defines compute and interblock dependencies. Partition a self-made 2D grid into four blocks. The alternative "Finer blocks always reduce total runtime." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 域分解：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「域分解」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
